groups.conflict_note: State law sets only a vague 'unconscionable' standard and explicitly defers to municipal rent control ordinances where they exist, so numeric caps come from local law.
groups.interaction: State law requires rent increases not be 'unconscionable' and must comply with any local rent control ordinance; local caps govern where they exist.

groups.conflict_note: This state law exempts newly constructed multi-family buildings from local rent control ordinances for 30 years, overriding municipal rent control for qualifying units.
groups.interaction: Overrides/limits local rent control ordinances by exempting newly constructed buildings for 30 years after completion.
